description: Records that you scheduled a routine for this person (with routines_suggest's prompt and time), and in which client, so it is never offered again.

client.description: Where it was set up: claude, chatgpt or other. Default: this connection's assistant

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

title: Routine scheduled
